items.excerpt: Etivaz is made only during the summer months in remote mountain chalets, every wheel of L’Etivaz AOP is crafted over…
items.name: Airelle Perrouin for Etivaz AOP
items.description_html: Etivaz is made only during the summer months in remote mountain chalets, every wheel of L’Etivaz AOP is crafted over traditional wood-fired copper vats using milk from cows grazing on wildflower-filled Alpine meadows. The cheese is beautifully complex with fruity, floral notes along with a delicate hint of smoke.

items.excerpt: Authentic Sicilian foods, olive oils, delicacies.

items.description_html:

Partnering with select producers, they bring genuine Southern Italian flavours to homes and businesses, celebrating Sicily’s heritage and culinary excellence in every product.

items.excerpt: Premium British nuts, oils, sustainable produce.
items.name: Nut Farms
items.description_html:
Nut Farms are Kent-based producers of premium British nuts and oils, known for roasted cobnuts, English walnuts, nut butters and cold-pressed oils.

Committed to provenance and sustainability, they deliver authentic, flavourful nuts and nut products to markets, online customers, and food businesses, showcasing the best of British-grown produce.

items.excerpt: Artisan sourdough, pastries, fresh daily bakes.
items.name: Fingal’s Bakery
items.description_html:
Fingal’s Bakery are artisan bakers in Greenwich, London, creating naturally leavened sourdough, rye breads, pastries and sweet treats using traditional methods. Their range includes seeded sourdough, ciabatta, pain au chocolat, almond croissants and cinnamon buns all baked fresh daily.

Craftsmanship and quality are at the heart of their bakery, with slow fermentation and stone deck ovens delivering exceptional flavour. They supply cafés, restaurants and markets, and invite visitors to enjoy their award‑worthy bakes in their café or at home.

items.excerpt: Leading independent distributor of artisan food and drink.
items.name: Curd & Cure
items.description_html:
Curd & Cure are the South East’s leading independent artisan food and drink distributor, supplying some of the UK’s finest speciality producers since 1988. Based in Kent, they work closely with a trusted network of small and large producers to source and deliver outstanding quality products.

With over 1,400 artisan deli, farm shop and foodservice lines available for next-day national delivery, and a flexible pallet consolidation service for Europe, Curd & Cure are a key link between great producers and great food businesses.

They are proud to be the exclusive UK stockist of the newly crowned 2025 World Champion Cheese, Le Gruyère AOP, and are delighted to showcase this exceptional cheese at the market.

items.excerpt: Award-winning organic cheesemakers rooted in sustainability.
items.name: Feltham’s Farm
items.description_html:
Feltham’s Farm are organic cheesemakers from the Blackmore Vale in South Somerset, best known for Renegade Monk, their multi award-winning ale-washed cheese made with local organic cow’s milk. Their range also includes Rebel Nun, Gert Lush, La Fresca Margarita and Lucky Marcel – all Great Taste Award winners, with Lucky Marcel taking Super Gold at the World Cheese Awards 2024.

Sustainability sits at the heart of the farm, powered by solar energy, ground source heat pumps and rare breed pigs that recycle whey, alongside tree planting and organic farming practices certified by the Soil Association. Founders of the Organic Cheesemakers’ Network, Feltham’s Farm champion organic principles in British cheese.

They regularly trade at London farmers’ markets and are delighted to share their cheeses with new customers – including their light, fresh La Fresca Margarita, a standout organic queso fresco.

items.excerpt: Crafted by hand using live edge timber, Sawn by Sarah creates unique homewares and gifts full of natural beauty.
items.name: Sawn by Sarah
items.description_html: Using live edge timber and occasionally blending in epoxy resin, Sarah crafts unique home decor and gifting pieces that highlight the wood’s natural grain, knots, and organic voids. Ready to ship offerings span from charcuterie boards, coaster sets, and egg holders to candle holders and sculptural side and coffee tables, each infused with warmth and artisan flair. For those seeking something personal, bespoke commissions are warmly welcomed to bring your vision to life.

items.excerpt: Somerset dairy specialising in cheeses made from goats and sheep milk with some Jersey cows milk cheese too. Don’t miss their Taste 3 star award-winning Driftwood and Tor.
items.name: White Lake Cheese
items.description_html: White Lake’s home is at Bagborough Farm, just near to the Glastonbury Festival site in Somerset. Roger Longman, the 3rd generation owner makes cheese from his own own beloved herd of, primarily, French Alpine goats. A local Guernsey herd provide the cow’s milk, and the sheep’s milk comes from another well trusted farm. The result is minimal food miles, support from the community, and – of course – truly exceptional cheese.
